paraphrased_notes: IM6, IM8 and IM10 use the documented difference products 4f1-2f2, 5f1-3f2 and 6f1-4f2 respectively; the balanced odd products are 3f1-2f2 through 6f1-5f2 for orders 5 through 11.
Signed tone orders and their multiplicities must match the chosen intercept definition.
The even-order output intercept offsets used here are 13, 11, 9 and 8 dB above output P1dB for orders 4, 6, 8 and 10.
The exact automatic odd-order coefficient algorithm is proprietary and is not specified by this help page.
